name: Herpesviruses: HSV, VZV, EBV and CMV

reference.source: Paniker's Textbook of Medical Parasitology 8th Ed + Ananthanarayan and Paniker's Textbook of Microbiology (topic maps; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Temporal aphasia with fever: aciclovir first

reference.pathophysiology: Retrograde axonal transport parks genomes in ganglia reactivating on stress; EBV immortalises B cells via LMP driving lymphomas, and CMV blunts immunity seeding retina and gut in grafted hosts.
